result.summary: The page is generally well laid out, but there is a duplicate restaurant listing and some low-contrast text.

issues.description: The first two cards in “Fastest near you” appear identical, including the restaurant name, image, delivery time, and fee.
issues.suggestion: Remove the duplicate or add distinguishing information if these are separate locations.

issues.description: The search placeholder and inactive bottom navigation labels have low contrast against their backgrounds.
issues.suggestion: Darken the text and icons to improve readability and meet applicable contrast requirements.
